interface.signature: def insertToAVL(root: TreeNode, value: int) -> TreeNode:

preconditions.expression: root is None or isinstance(root, TreeNode)
preconditions.description: The root is either None (empty tree) or a valid TreeNode instance.
The value to be inserted is an integer.

preconditions.expression: all(isinstance(node, TreeNode) for node in [root] + [root.left, root.right] if node is not None)
preconditions.description: If root is not None, its left and right children (if they exist) are also valid TreeNode instances.

postconditions.expression: return_value is None or isinstance(return_value, TreeNode)
postconditions.description: The returned root is either None (empty tree) or a valid TreeNode instance.

postconditions.expression: all(isinstance(node, TreeNode) for node in [return_value] + [return_value.left, return_value.right] if node is not None)
postconditions.description: If the returned root is not None, its left and right children (if they exist) are also valid TreeNode instances.

postconditions.expression: any(node.val == value for node in [return_value] + [return_value.left, return_value.right] if node is not None) if return_value is not None else False
postconditions.description: The inserted value exists in the tree rooted at return_value.

postconditions.expression: all(abs((node.left.height if node.left else 0) - (node.right.height if node.right else 0)) <= 1 for node in [return_value] + [return_value.left, return_value.right] if node is not None)
postconditions.description: The returned tree satisfies the AVL balance property: the height difference between left and right subtrees of every node is at most 1.

postconditions.expression: all(node.val > (node.left.val if node.left else -float('inf')) and node.val < (node.right.val if node.right else float('inf')) for node in [return_value] + [return_value.left, return_value.right] if node is not None and node.left is not None and node.right is not None)
postconditions.description: The returned tree satisfies the BST property: for every node, all values in the left subtree are less than the node's value, and all values in the right subtree are greater.
